pasteHelp.message: Paste otpauth:// links, Google Authenticator export links, or plain keys (a key alone, or name|key), one per line, or choose files below. Nothing is added until you confirm.

dropOrPasteImage.message: or drop files here: text, JSON or CSV exports (Aegis, 2FAS, andOTP, Raivo, Bitwarden) and QR images. Paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V.

previewDup.message: $1 already in your list or repeated, skipped

previewIncomplete.message: Google export: $1 of $2 codes read. Still needed: $3.

previewHotp.message: $1 counter-based account(s) will be kept but cannot generate codes yet.

previewShort.message: $1 account(s) use a short key. They will work, but the service issued a weak key.

incompleteHint.message: Add the remaining codes first, or add what you have.

rNotOtpauth.message: not a link or a key

googleStep1.message: In Google Authenticator, choose Transfer accounts, then Export accounts. It shows one or more QR codes.

googleStep2.message: Scan each code with the camera here, or take screenshots and choose or drop them above.

googleStep3.message: Delete the screenshots and exported files afterwards: they contain your keys.

addLead.message: Bring accounts in from links, files, QR images, the camera, or by typing a key. Nothing is added until you confirm.

linesHelp.message: $1 line(s) have columns split by |. Only the key column and the name column are read. Every other column, such as a password, is dropped and never saved.

linesColumn.message: Column $1 · $2 characters · a key in $3 of $4 lines

linesPending.message: Choose the key column: $1 line(s) are not added until you do.

linesFromText.message: $1 from plain text, set to 6 digits every 30 seconds, the usual setting. Check that each is a real 2FA key.

linesUnnamed.message: $1 without a name. You can name them in the popup after adding.

rNotKey.message: too short for a key (16 characters or more)

addNothing.message: Paste links, choose a file or scan a QR code first.

camHint.message: Hold the QR code up to the camera.

camDenied.message: Sixkey is not allowed to use the camera. Allow it with the camera icon in the address bar or in this extension's site settings (on a Mac, also in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Camera).

camFailed.message: The camera could not be started: there is none, or another app is using it.

camOther.message: This code is from another Google Authenticator export. Finish this one first, or add what you have.

fileNotText.message: Not a text, JSON, CSV or image file.

fileZip.message: A ZIP archive. Unzip it, then choose the file inside.

fileEncrypted.message: An encrypted $1 export, which Sixkey cannot open. Export it again without encryption, then choose that file.

fileIsBackup.message: A Sixkey backup: import it under Backup.

fileHtml.message: A web page export: its codes are only pictures. Scan them with the camera, or choose screenshots of them.

delAsk.message: $1 holds your secret keys in plain text. Delete it now?

delPlain.message: $1 holds your secret keys in plain text.

delNote.message: Deleting does not guarantee it cannot be recovered.

delLeft.message: Accounts in it not imported: $1. Deleting the file loses them.

delHotp.message: Counter-based (HOTP) accounts from it: $1. Sixkey keeps them but cannot make their codes yet.

delChanged.message: $1 changed after Sixkey read it, so it was not deleted.

delManual.message: Delete it yourself: move it to the Trash or Recycle Bin, then empty it.
